caseNameFull: Roddewig, Chairman v. Sears, Roebuck & Co. and Same v. Montgomery Ward & Co., Inc.
attorneys: Messrs. John M. Rankin, Attorney General of Iowa, and John E. Mulroney, Assistant Attorney General, for petitioners. Messrs. Charles Lederer, Joseph G. Gamble, and Ralph L. Read for respondent in No. 255. Messrs. Stuart S. Ball and Maxwell A. O’Brien for respondent in No. 256.

opinions.text:
Petition for writs of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Iowa granted.

Mr. Justice Stone and Mr. Justice Roberts took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.

Reported below: 228 Iowa 1273, 1301; 292 N. W. 130, 142.
